1. What is the capital of Hungary?
A. Vienna
B. Budapest
C. Prague
D. Warsaw
ANSWER: B

2. Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
A. Venus
B. Mars
C. Earth
D. Jupiter
ANSWER: B

3. Melyik Magyarország fővárosa?
A. Bécs
B. Budapest
C. Prága
D. Varsó
ANSWER: B

4. Какая столица Венгрии?
A. Вена
B. Будапешт
C. Прага
D. Варшава
ANSWER: B

5. Which symbol means less than?
A. >
B. <
C. =
D. ≥
ANSWER: B

6. Which option contains an ampersand?
A. R&D
B. Research
C. Development
D. None
ANSWER: A

7. Which emoji is a unicorn?
A. 🐴
B. 🦄
C. 🐐
D. 🦓
ANSWER: B

8. Which answer contains XML-sensitive literal text?
A. R&D uses <research> tags
B. Plain text
C. Only &
D. Only <angle brackets>
ANSWER: A
